body.command: grep -n -i "toleran\|interpreter\|samples" experiments/EXP-ICPERF-28*/runbook.yaml | head; for s in experiments/EXP-ICPERF-284bc4/runbook-sessions/RBS-ICPERF-8cdc92:6 experiments/EXP-ICPERF-283a70/runbook-sessions/RBS-ICPERF-67df7d:3; do CHECKPOINT_SKIP="audit replay, not an experiment run" timeout 1200 python3 tools/runbook.py audit ${s%:*} --samples ${s#*:} --auditor "coordinator/claude-opus-5-5" 2>&1 | tail -25; done

sed -n 1,32p tests/test_ci_workflow_gates.py; CHECKPOINT_SKIP=read-only grep -n "check name\|\"name\"\|job_name\|merge-hygiene\|ledger-and-harness\|lab-parity" .github/scripts/merge_sweeper.py .github/scripts/draft_tier_gate.py .github/scripts/autofix_triage.py tools/sync_open_branches.py tools/goal_head.py | head -20

CHECKPOINT_SKIP=read-only grep -n "def resolve_base" -A45 .github/scripts/ci_scope.py; CHECKPOINT_SKIP=read-only grep -n "resolve_base\|closed\|pull_request_target" .github/scripts/test_ci_scope.py | head -20

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='.github/scripts/ci_scope.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''        parents = git("rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", "HEAD").split()
        if len(parents) < 2:
            raise ValueError("merged main commit has no parent")
        base = parents[1]
'''
new='''        parents = git("rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", "HEAD").split()
        if len(parents) < 2:
            raise ValueError("merged main commit has no parent")
        # HEAD must be THIS PR's merge commit. With two merges before the
        # checkout, HEAD^1..HEAD would be another PR's diff attributed to this
        # one (SHF-20261106-a114e7, CIX-3).
        pull = event["pull_request"]
        merge_sha = pull.get("merge_commit_sha")
        head_sha = (pull.get("head") or {}).get("sha")
        if merge_sha and parents[0] != merge_sha:
            raise ValueError(f"checked-out commit {parents[0]} is not this PR's merge commit "
                             f"{merge_sha}; refusing to attribute another diff to it")
        if len(parents) > 2 and head_sha and parents[2] != head_sha:
            raise ValueError(f"checked-out merge commit's second parent {parents[2]} is not "
                             f"this PR's head {head_sha}")
        base = parents[1]
'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.github/scripts/test_ci_scope.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''                self.assertEqual(scope.resolve_base({"merge_group": {"base_sha": current_base}}, "merge_group"),
                                 (current_base, False))
'''
new='''                self.assertEqual(scope.resolve_base({"merge_group": {"base_sha": current_base}}, "merge_group"),
                                 (current_base, False))
                # Post-merge (pull_request_target closed): HEAD must be this
                # PR's merge commit, whose second parent is the PR head
                # (SHF-20261106-a114e7, CIX-3).
                merge = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
                feature = git("rev-parse", "feature")
                closed = {"action": "closed", "pull_request": {
                    "merged": True, "merge_commit_sha": merge, "head": {"sha": feature}}}
                self.assertEqual(scope.resolve_base(closed, "pull_request_target"),
                                 (current_base, False))
                git("checkout", "-qb", "other", current_base)
                (repo / "src/other.py").write_text("other = True\\n")
                git("add", ".")
                git("commit", "-qm", "other")
                git("checkout", "-q", "main")
                git("merge", "--no-ff", "-m", "second merge", "other")
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "not this PR's merge commit"):
                    scope.resolve_base(closed, "pull_request_target")
                without_merge_sha = {"action": "closed", "pull_request": {
                    "merged": True, "head": {"sha": feature}}}
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "is not this PR's head"):
                    scope.resolve_base(without_merge_sha, "pull_request_target")
                self.assertEqual(scope.resolve_base(
                    {"action": "closed", "pull_request": {"merged": False}}, "pull_request_target"),
                    (None, True))
'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
CHECKPOINT_SKIP=unit-tests python3 -m pytest -q .github/scripts/test_ci_scope.py 2>&1 | tail -3
git diff pcc/ledger.jsonl | head -20 | cut -c1-300; CHECKPOINT_SKIP=read-only grep -rn "pcc/ledger" AGENTS.md | head -5

CHECKPOINT_SKIP=unit-tests-only timeout 900 python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_experiment_execution.py tests/test_runbook.py tests/test_runbook_audit_tolerance.py tests/test_runbook_session_collision.py tests/test_runbook_replay_compare.py tests/test_check_run_source_provenance.py tests/test_ci_post_merge_check_names.py tests/test_ci_workflow_gates.py tests/test_ci_sparse_guard.py tools/test_check_merge_hygiene.py tools/test_progress_metrics.py .github/scripts/test_ci_scope.py tools/test_validate_ledger.py 2>&1 | tail -5; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_progress_*.py' 2>&1 | tail -2
